pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Reminders"
    set listNames to {"Groceries", "Errands"}
    repeat with aListName in listNames
        try
            set listToDelete to list aListName
            delete listToDelete
        on error
        end try
    end repeat
    repeat with aListName in listNames
        make new list with properties {name:aListName}
    end repeat
    set groceryItems to {"Buy milk", "Loaf of bread", "Jar of mustard", "Dozen eggs", "Fresh lettuce"}
    set groceriesList to list "Groceries"
    repeat with anItem in groceryItems
        make new reminder at end of groceriesList with properties {name:anItem}
    end repeat
end tell
' && osascript -e 'tell application "Reminders" to quit' && sleep 2
instruction: Move the reminder 'Buy milk' from the 'Groceries' list to the 'Errands' list.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "Reminders" to try
set errandsList to first list whose name is "Errands"
set remindersList to reminders of errandsList
set inErrands to false
repeat with aReminder in remindersList
if name of aReminder is "Buy milk" then
set inErrands to true
exit repeat
end if
end repeat
set groceriesList to first list whose name is "Groceries"
set remindersList to reminders of groceriesList
set inGroceries to false
repeat with aReminder in remindersList
if name of aReminder is "Buy milk" then
set inGroceries to true
exit repeat
end if
end repeat
if (inErrands and not inGroceries) then
return "True"
else
return "False"
end if
on error
return "False"
end try'
